_note: visual_verify expectations for a filled 지원사업 신청 packet (pipeline/scripts/visual_verify.py --expectations). Modules are the natural author of this file and there is no provides key for it: it is ordinary payload the caller passes. This family's balance is its own: unlike 민원, where nothing printed may disappear, a 지원사업 form INSTRUCTS the applicant to remove things ('※ 해당 안내를 포함한, 아래 파란색 안내 문구는 참고하여 작성 후 삭제', '※ 해당자에 한함 (없을 시 삭제)'), so forbidden_text carries real weight here — it is the render-side twin of check_grant's self_deleting_guide_retained and example_placeholder_retained. intentionally_blank is the identity and signature half.
_forbidden_text_note: Every entry is something the FORM told the applicant to remove, not a preference of ours. The guide-deletion instruction includes itself ('해당 안내를 포함한'), the ~~~~ and ㅇㅇㅇ runs are the form's worked-example stand-ins where the applicant's own words and name go, and '예시)' marks the sample rows beside them. A render still showing any of them is a packet that went out with its scaffolding attached.
protected_text: 조달청은 우수제품 심사를 위하여 아래와 같이 개인정보를 수집ㆍ이용 및 제3자에게 제공하고자 합니다.  내용을 자세히 읽으신 후 동의 여부를 결정하여 주십시오.
※ 위의 개인정보 수집ㆍ이용에 대한 동의를 거부할 권리가 있습니다. 그러나 동의를 거부할 경우 원활한 우수제품심사를 할 수 없어 공정조달시스템 이용이 제한됩니다.
※ 위의 개인정보 제공에 대한 동의를 거부할 권리가 있습니다. 그러나 동의를 거부할 경우 원활한 우수제품심사를 할 수 없어 공정조달시스템 이용이 제한됩니다.
_protected_text_note: The exact opposite claim to forbidden_text, and this family needs both: a 지원사업 form tells the applicant to delete its own scaffolding, while a 동의서 carries 고지 that is legally required to STAY (개인정보 보호법 §22 — the 동의 거부권 and the 불이익 that follows refusing). Those paragraphs look exactly like removable guide text to core — note_prefix ※, black, instructional — so they land in removal_targets and check_residue holds their text in the forbidden set, and before this key the ONLY route to a green residue gate was a hand-written --keep. T31 recorded that shape as a defect, not as the interface. The vocabulary belongs here rather than in core (T43): core consumes a module list, it does not contain one. Measured on pps-jeongbogonggae-donguiseo after T110: these three ARE every remaining removal target on the blank form, so a 동의서 has no deletable guide text at all — which is the right answer for a document whose every printed sentence is either a field or a legal notice. Entries must be the whole paragraph, normalized: check_residue matches a keep against the entire inventory entry, not a substring of it.
_intentionally_blank_note: Two classes, both things the TOOL must leave alone: the per-sheet signature seats a person completes by hand (check_grant's signature_seat_lost — this family signs once per sheet, six seats in the kstartup packet alone), and the identity and account seats a tool never fabricates (identity_value_invented / account_number_invented). The consent choice is deliberately ABSENT from this list: an unmarked required consent is a defect (consent_unmarked), but MARKING it is the applicant's decision, so the render expectation cannot demand either state.
_page_budget_note: page_budget is NOT declared, and that is a corpus finding rather than an omission. The landscape write-up predicts per-section page budgets for this family ('5쪽 이내'); no corpus form declares one — check_grant's page_budget_re matches zero times across all three — so there is no number to put here. If a 공고 form does declare one, this is where it goes: visual_verify owns the rendered page count, which is exactly why check_grant reports length_budget_unverified as skipped:needs_render instead of guessing.
_fill_map_note: No fill_map is declared here. Everything a 지원사업 packet fill writes — 기업명, 대표자명, 성명, 주소, 연락처, 과제명, budget figures, dates — is per-document data belonging to the caller's own fill map, and shipping a specimen in module payload would be shipping personal and commercial data.
